content: देव {%a.%} (-वी|{%f.%}) [दिव्-अच्] .²1 Divine, celestial; <ls>Bg. 11. 11</ls>; <ls>Ms. 12. 117</ls>. .²2 Shining; यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् <ls>Rv. 1. 1. 1</ls>. .²3 Fit to be worshipped or honoured. .{@-वः@} .²1 A god, deity; एको देवः केशवो वा शिवो वा <ls>Bh. 3. 120</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) The god of rain, an epithet of Indra; as in द्वादश वर्षाणि देवो न ववर्ष; अवर्षयदेवः <ls>Rām. 1. 9. 18</ls>; काले च देशे च प्रबवर्ष देवः <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 7</ls>. .³({%b%}) A cloud. .²3 A divine man, Brāhmaṇa, as in भूदेव. .²4 A king, ruler, as in मनुष्यदेव; तां देवसमितिं (अभ्यागच्छत्) <ls>Mb. 3. 130. 22</ls>. .²5 A title affixed to the names of Bārhmaṇas; as in गोविन्ददेव, पुरुषोत्तमदेव <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 (In dramas) A title of honour used in addressing a king, (‘My lord’, ‘Your majesty’); ततश्च देव <ls>Ve. 4</ls>; यथाज्ञापयति देवः <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 Quicksilver. .²8 The Supreme Spirit; हित्वा च देहं प्रविशन्ति देवं दिवौकसो द्यामिव पार्थ सांख्याः <ls>Mb. 12. 301. 112</ls>. .²9 A fool .²10 A child. .²11 A man following any particular business. .²12 A lover. .²13 Emulation. .²14 Sport, play. .²15 A husbandʼs brother (<ab>cf.</ab> देवृ, देवर). .²16 A lancer. .{@-वम्@} An organ of sense; देवानां प्रभवो देवो मनसश्च त्रिलोककृत् <ls>Mb. 14. 41. 3</ls>. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%deus%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%deos%}].
